Thanks again for the conversation this morning — great to hear more about Finexa's use cases for inference (high-throughput embeddings for search + low-latency chat for advisors). High-level recap and next steps below:

- Goal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (demo + SRE/infra discussion) to align on latency SLOs, data residency, and deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Attendees we suggest: Product/Engineering from Finexa, your SRE/Platform contact, our Solutions Eng (Aditya), and AE (Marissa).
- Deliverable: mutual-action-plan that captures success criteria and timeline — attached (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Scheduling note: to make it easy for teams across US / EU / APAC we usually run a 3-week rotating slot cadence so each rotation lands at friendly local times for one region. Proposal (pick any one slot for the first deep-dive):

Rotation A — US-friendly
- Option 1: Tue 9 Mar, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 GMT (60–90m)
- Option 2: Wed 10 Mar, 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET / 22:00 GMT

Rotation B — EU-friendly
- Option 3: Thu 11 Mar, 10:00 CET / 09:00 GMT / 02:00 PT
- Option 4: Fri 12 Mar, 11:00 CET / 10:00 GMT / 03:00 PT

Rotation C — APAC-friendly
- Option 5: Mon 15 Mar, 09:00 JST / 08:00 SGT / 00:00 UTC
- Option 6: Tue 16 Mar, 16:00 JST / 15:00 SGT / 07:00 UTC

We generally run the next deep-dive on whichever rotation works best for the majority; then flip to the next rotation for follow-ups so your team sees one early-morning friendly window every 3 weeks.

If you want to see my direct booking link, here it is: https://cal.com/camila/redwood-demo — or just reply with 1–2 preferred options and I’ll send the invite.

Attaching a short product overview as well.
